Name: ConditionalAccessEmergencyAccessSafeguard
Author: Araam Mamali - Araam.Mamali@microsoft.com
Description: The Conditional Access Emergency Access Safeguard solution provides a Microsoft Sentinel playbook that runs daily, checks every Microsoft Entra Conditional Access policy, and makes sure your two emergency access (break-glass) accounts are excluded. If an exclusion is missing, the playbook adds it through Microsoft Graph, re-reads the policy to verify the change, and emails the result. Supports Commercial, GCC High, and DoD Graph endpoints.
